identity_model.note: 本硬件三台设备 GetInt(PersistentID)/GetInt(TopologicalID) 均 0x80000003 (SDK 不支持); canonical 硬件身份 = DeviceHandle (GetString 'devh'). DeviceHandle 是当前主机 best-available, 非跨机器/重启永久稳定.

device_id_rule: UUIDv5(VBMF_BMD_NS, 'vbmf:bmd:'+canonical); canonical = PersistentID|DeviceHandle|Serial|枚举 (按优先级首个可用)
